findings.title: The publishing workspace leaves private content visible after logout
findings.scenario: Tom opens an unpublished draft, then uses Log out without leaving the publishing workspace. Zoe can still read Tom's draft on that screen because signing out changes the account menu but never clears or hides the workspace.
findings.test_needed: Open Tom's unpublished draft, log out through the header, and assert its content and publishing controls disappear without reloading.

owner_question.question: When Tom logs out with an unpublished draft open, what should Zoe see on that screen?
options: Hide the workspace immediately and retain the unsaved draft only for Tom
Hide the workspace immediately and discard unsaved changes
Leave Tom's draft visible until navigation or reload (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Saving a publishing draft can silently erase edits made during the save
findings.scenario: Lina saves a draft and continues changing its title while the save is still finishing. When the earlier save completes, the older title replaces her newer text and the workspace says the draft is saved. Lina loses the newer change without an unsaved-changes warning.
findings.test_needed: Delay a draft-save response, change Lina's title while it is pending, complete the response, and assert the newer title remains unsaved.

owner_question.question: If Lina continues editing while her draft saves, what should happen to those newer changes?
options: Keep Lina's newer changes and mark them unsaved
Temporarily prevent editing until the save finishes
Replace newer changes with the completed save (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: The public catalogue cannot browse beyond its first 24 matching listings
findings.scenario: Tom's approved listing becomes the twenty-fifth result after newer items are published. Sara sees a total of twenty-five approved listings, but only twenty-four cards and no next page or load-more action. She cannot discover Tom's item by continuing through the catalogue.
findings.test_needed: Provide twenty-five matching approved listings and assert Sara can reach the twenty-fifth through catalogue pagination.

owner_question.question: How should Sara discover Tom's listing when more than twenty-four approved items match her filters?
options: Sara can page through every matching listing
Clearly label the latest twenty-four and offer search for older items
Show the full count but only the first twenty-four cards (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: New learning resources cannot be published into the Learning page
findings.scenario: Lina publishes a new clinical lesson through the publishing workspace. Sara's Learning page never shows it because none of Lina's available topics matches the topic that page requires. The publishing service also rejects that required topic, so Lina cannot publish a new lesson into Learning through the supported workflow.
findings.test_needed: Publish a new learning resource through Lina's editorial workspace and assert it appears on Sara's Learning page.

owner_question.question: How should Lina publish a resource that Sara can find on the Learning page?
options: Give Lina a supported Learning topic in the editor and publishing service
Include selected existing topics such as Careers and Pharmacy practice on Learning
Keep Learning limited to separately seeded resources (keep today's behaviour)
